scoreboard_when: transaction enters and exits a data path
multi-master/multi-slave routing or ordering must be checked
cross-subsystem result must match a reference model
checker_when: protocol legality or sequencing must be validated
configuration/register programming must match expected behavior

evidence_rules: Calibrated architecture and regression evidence drive placement.
